Let \(a=x-y>0\), \(b=y-z>0\), and \(S=a+b=x-z>0\). Then the inequality becomes
\[
\frac1a+\frac1b-\frac{\lambda}{S}\ge 0.
\]
For fixed \(S=a+b\),
\[
\frac1a+\frac1b \ge \frac{4}{a+b}=\frac4S,
\]
with equality when \(a=b\). Therefore the inequality holds for all \(a,b>0\) iff
\[
\frac4S-\frac{\lambda}{S}\ge 0 \iff \lambda\le 4.
\]
Thus the maximum value is \(\lambda=4\).

\[
\boxed{4}
\]
